claim_boundary: Train-only amendment correcting the distinction between a full-UniProt PINDER AlphaFold monomer and the experimental holo construct sequence. Alignment uses amino-acid strings only; PINDER bound-coordinate availability and resolved-residue flags are not model inputs.

rationale.discovery_stage: predicted-structure cache preprocessing before any multimodal optimization update
rationale.observed_contract_error: One full-UniProt predicted monomer can legitimately correspond to multiple holo fragments or engineered constructs.

structure_alignment.algorithm: Biopython PairwiseAligner global alignment with free terminal gaps
alignment_inputs: holo amino-acid sequence already present in the frozen train-only inventory
full predicted-monomer amino-acid sequence parsed from the authenticated PINDER AlphaFold PDB
structure_alignment.ambiguous_optimum_policy: mask the entire structure modality for that member-sequence association and retain an explicit audit record
structure_alignment.per_residue_policy: inject predicted geometry only when the aligned holo and predicted residues are identical and neither residue is X; tag, insertion, deletion, mutation, ambiguous, and low-confidence positions are masked

preregistered_gate.policy_for_below_gate_associations: retain sequence and labels but set the complete structure mask to missing; do not silently drop the physical system
